Do you offer free educational licenses for students and teachers?

Updated 07 January 2026 17:05

Yes! Students and teachers can get the JetBrains Student or Teacher Pack for free. It includes IntelliJ IDEA Ultimate, ReSharper, and all other JetBrains IDEs and .NET tools. Just note that educational licenses can’t be used for commercial work.

For students, we also offer a 40% graduation discount you can use to buy a personal subscription for any single JetBrains product or the All Products Pack. It’s valid for 2 years after your student license expires.

If you’re with an educational organization and need multiple licenses to teach classes, you can apply free classroom licenses.
